title: Hybrid Momentum Methods for Optimizing Deep Learning Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27674v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Momentum is central to stochastic optimization in deep learning, including the training of large language models. Classical momentum methods typically rely on a fast exponential moving average (EMA) scheme, which discounts past gradients on a fixed timescale and may underweight older gradients that remain informative. This creates a trade-off between retaining long-term history and adapting to recent changes. We introduce Hybrid Momentum (HyM), which combines a linearly weighted average of past gradients with a geometrically discounted fast momentum. The former assigns weights proportional to the gradients' iteration indices and retains a growing span of history, while the latter emphasizes recent gradients. This hybrid construction is modular and can be combined with adaptive preconditioning and other update transformations. In particular, we propose HyMUON, which applies Newton--Schulz orthogonalization to the hybrid direction. Illustr

translated_title: 用于优化深度学习模型的混合动量方法
translated_abstract: 动量是深度学习随机优化的核心，包括大语言模型的训练。经典动量方法通常依赖快速的指数移动平均（EMA）方案，该方案以固定的时间尺度对过去的梯度进行折扣，可能低估那些仍然具有信息价值的较早梯度。这在保留长期历史与适应近期变化之间造成了权衡。我们提出混合动量（HyM），它将过去梯度的线性加权平均与几何折扣的快动量相结合。前者按梯度迭代索引成比例地分配权重，并保留不断增长的历史跨度；后者则强调近期梯度。这种混合结构是模块化的，可以与自适应预处理及其他更新变换相结合。特别地，我们提出HyMUON，它对混合方向应用Newton–Schulz正交化。
tldr: 提出混合动量方法HyM，将线性加权的长期历史梯度与几何折扣的快动量相结合，并据此构建经Newton–Schulz正交化的HyMUON优化器，在保留长期梯度信息与适应近期变化之间实现平衡。
